environment.browser: Chromium through Playwright in local container
environment.backend: Actual AssemblyScript/WASM in private browser and Node workers

contract.target: Selected or explicit raster; original decoded pixels before layer effects/masks/opacity
contract.placement: Full ancestor/layer affine matrix multiplied by placed-to-native-source scale

expandRadius.units: Original source pixels, grayscale disk dilation before placement, clipped to source

contract.heuristic: Visible-border RGB mean; majority-transparent border uses intrinsic alpha. Otherwise normalized encoded-RGB contrast plus Sobel edge and spatial weighting, without fabricated prior/fallback.
contract.alpha: Selected coverage copies native source byte alpha; hidden RGB under zero alpha is ignored
contract.confidence: Synchronous reference reports zero as unscored, not calibrated subject confidence
contract.emptyUniformMissingOrNonRaster: Reject without replacing selection/history or fabricating a source/shape

memory.note: Browser capture/transferred input, original source decoding/bitmaps, RLE/history and bounded expansion tiles consume additional memory. The WASM maximum and actual process memory limit this operation; they do not cap imports or downsample originals.

performanceNotes: The 50 MP fixture is a genuine mostly-transparent PNG that exercises intrinsic-alpha evidence, not a 50 MP Sobel/contrast benchmark. Smaller opaque/textured inputs verify the contrast branch against an independent JavaScript reference. Toolbar timing is a queued zero-delay callback clicking the real Hand control during trusted source capture and observing its pressed state before first capture completion, not OS input-to-photon or gesture p95. Overlapping long tasks remain and can include other browser work. These container observations do not establish cross-device performance or peak memory.

fixtures.generation: Independent Python struct/zlib standard PNG scanlines; no full-image allocation in generator, no Canoli writer or image model used.

validation.build: npm run build passed actual WASM, isolated runtime, developer docs, TypeScript and Vite
validation.independentReference: Native byte coverage versus independent JavaScript scorer on textured nonrectangular input, four thresholds and two expansion radii
validation.hiddenRgbInvariance: Actual failing native regression at threshold 0.1 reproduced, then fixed for four threshold settings
validation.limits: Legacy mocked Canvas matting tests establish ownership/history only; they are not quality evidence. Actual native/PNG/browser tests provide the pixel coverage checks.
